description: 描述主体为预防、减轻或补救价值链劳动者重大负面影响而已采取、计划或正在进行的行动。

labels.en: Description of action planned or underway to prevent, mitigate or remediate material negative impacts on  value chain workers
labels.zh: 预防、减轻或补救价值链劳动者负面影响的行动

description: 说明主体是否以及如何针对价值链劳动者的实际重大影响采取提供或促成补救的行动。

labels.en: Description of whether and how action to provide or enable remedy in relation to an actual material impact
labels.zh: 对实际重大影响提供或促成补救的行动（价值链）

description: 描述以向价值链劳动者传递积极影响为主要目的的其他举措或流程。

labels.en: Description of additional initiatives or processes with primary purpose of delivering positive impacts for value chain workers
labels.zh: 为价值链劳动者带来积极影响的其他举措

description: 说明主体如何跟踪和评估行动或举措在改善价值链劳动者结果方面的有效性。

labels.en: Description of how effectiveness of actions or initiatives in delivering outcomes for value chain workersis tracked and assessed
labels.zh: 行动与举措有效性的跟踪评估（价值链）

description: 描述主体针对价值链劳动者特定实际或潜在重大负面影响确定所需适当行动的流程。

labels.en: Description of processes to identifying what action is needed and appropriate in response to particular actual or potential material negative impact on  value chain workers
labels.zh: 确定所需行动的流程（价值链劳动者）

description: 描述主体针对价值链劳动者特定重大负面影响采取行动的方法。

labels.en: Description of approach to taking action in relation to specific material negative impacts on value chain workers
labels.zh: 针对价值链劳动者重大负面影响的行为方法

description: 描述主体如何确保在价值链劳动者发生重大负面影响时，补救流程可得、可实施且结果有效。

labels.en: Description of approach to ensuring that processes to provide or enable remedy in event of material negative impacts on  value chain workers  are available and effective in their implementation and outcomes
labels.zh: 确保补救流程可用有效的机制

description: 描述为缓解因对价值链劳动者的影响和依赖所产生的重大风险而计划或正在进行的行动，以及有效性跟踪方式。

labels.en: Description of what action is planned or underway to mitigate material risks arising from impacts and dependencies on  value chain workers  and how effectiveness is tracked
labels.zh: 缓解价值链劳动者重大风险的行动

description: 描述为把握与价值链劳动者相关的重大机遇而计划或正在进行的行动。

labels.en: Description of what action is planned or underway to pursue material opportunities in relation to  value chain workers
labels.zh: 把握价值链劳动者相关重大机遇的行动

description: 说明主体如何确保自身实践不会造成或促成对价值链劳动者的重大负面影响。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how it is ensured that own practices do not cause or contribute to material negative impacts on value chain workers
labels.zh: 确保自身实践不造成价值链负面影响的机制

description: 披露与上下游价值链相关的严重人权问题和事件，包括类型、地点和处置情况。

labels.en: Disclosure of severe human rights issues and incidents connected to upstream and downstream value chain
labels.zh: 价值链中的严重人权问题与事件

description: 披露为管理价值链劳动者重大影响所分配的资源，包括人员、预算和管理层投入。

labels.en: Disclosure of resources allocated to management of material impacts
labels.zh: 管理价值链劳动者重大影响的资源分配

description: 说明主体是否以及如何利用与相关业务关系的杠杆来管理影响价值链劳动者的重大负面影响。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how undertaking seeks to use leverage with relevant business relationships to manage material negative impacts affecting value chain workers
labels.zh: 利用业务关系杠杆管理价值链负面影响

description: 说明主体参与行业或多利益相关方倡议的情况，以及其自身参与如何针对重大影响发挥作用。

labels.en: Disclosure of how participation in industry or multi-stakeholder initiative and undertaking's own involvement is aiming to address material impacts
labels.zh: 行业或多利益相关方倡议中的参与与作用

description: 说明价值链劳动者及其合法代表或可信代理是否以及如何在以积极影响为主要目的的项目或流程的设计与实施决策中发挥作用。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how value chain workers and legitimate representatives or their credible proxies play role in decisions regarding design and implementation of programmes or processes
labels.zh: 价值链劳动者在项目设计实施中的参与

description: 提供针对价值链劳动者的项目或流程的预期或已实现积极结果信息。

labels.en: Information about intended or achieved positive outcomes of programmes or processes for  value chain workers
labels.zh: 面向价值链劳动者的项目预期或已实现结果

description: 说明以积极影响价值链劳动者为主要目的的项目或流程是否同时支持实现一项或多项可持续发展目标。

labels.en: Initiatives or processes whose primary aim is to deliver positive impacts for  value chain workers  are designed also to support achievement of one or more of Sustainable Development Goals
labels.zh: 项目与可持续发展目标的衔接（价值链）

description: 描述参与价值链劳动者影响管理的内部职能，以及这些职能所采取的行动类型。

labels.en: Description of internal functions that are involved in managing impacts and types of action taken by internal functions to address negative and advance positive impacts
labels.zh: 参与影响管理的内部职能及行动类型（价值链）
